create_cluster_instance: create a Cluster dataclass instance with cluster ARN, name, pending tasks, and running tasks
create_cluster_with_tags: create a Cluster instance with custom AWS tags as a key-value dictionary
set_cluster_status: set a Cluster status to ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or UNKNOWN using the ClusterStatus enum
serialize_cluster_to_json: serialize a Cluster dataclass to JSON using the dataclasses_json decorator
deserialize_cluster_from_json: deserialize a Cluster dataclass from a JSON string using from_json
